verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk export or 'take your data and leave' feature. Data can still be pulled out programmatically through the authenticated REST API, which offers paginated list endpoints and sync tokens for incremental application retrieval and uses JSON payloads. The MCP server can also search and retrieve candidates, applications, jobs, interviews, offers, notes, feedback and other records. missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, explicit open-format exports (CSV/JSON dumps), coverage guarantees that all data types (e.g., notetaker transcripts, attachments) are exportable, offboarding/data-portability documentation, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a successful migration out.
